purpose: Localize the rejected protected-union pilot's score changes between the retained phylogeny candidate partition and final reconciled partition. This is not a new inference experiment, an accuracy-selection round, independent validation or permission to retune/reopen the stopped branch.
known_result: Protected-union final OrthoBench F1 0.7340884328689253 versus matched canonical 0.7410607351873405; strict pilot gate failed. Paired-family intervals do not change the stop decision. Candidate-level scores and stage contrasts have not been computed for this readout.

all_family_manifest.use: Use --partition all only. Require development plus validation names to equal all 70 scored RefOGs exactly. Both historical subsets are development-exposed; no subset is a new holdout.

analysis: Authenticate both admission receipts, native producer and retained candidate provenance. Require candidate pins to match their respective provenance_manifest input_cluster_sha256. Validate all four partitions as nonoverlapping complete identical 251378-gene sets before analysis; never drop difficult genes or families.

Use the unchanged frozen score_orthobench_partition.py CLI with --partition all for all four partitions into separate fresh JSON files. Use the same 70 reference files and all 11 low-certainty exclusions authenticated by the admitted cells. Reproduce each final partition's entire family-detail record and aggregate F1/precision/recall before interpreting candidate-level diagnostics. Crosscheck all four against the original official scorer through the existing score_orthobench helper.

Compare full native roots and unordered gene/species pair multisets using frozen compare_native_membership.py; preserve multiplicity and validate complete gene ownership/reconciliation counts. These turnover counts are not benchmark accuracy or proof of a uniquely causal stage.

Compare candidate-versus-final membership changes using the existing strict partition_contrast helper. For each of the 70 families preserve raw TP/FP/FN, reference size, splits and exactness in all four scores; report every family, not only gains or losses.

Report candidate and final between-policy F1/precision/recall deltas plus each policy's candidate-to-final changes in percentage points. Verify the telescoping identity: final policy difference = candidate policy difference + union candidate-to-final change - control candidate-to-final change. This is descriptive stage association, not independent causal decomposition.

If examining species trees, compare identical terminal taxon sets and canonical rooted clades/unrooted bipartitions using the structured Bio.Phylo parser. Do not infer topology change from unequal byte hashes or compare arbitrary family IDs as biological identities. No new tree inference or fixed-tree intervention is authorized.

Independently recheck results and input/source/runtime/reference pins after execution, leave the admitted score table and gate unchanged, and retain failed attempts and descriptive diagnostic resources.
tests: Run the existing frozen native-membership and OrthoBench scoring/helper tests before execution. No production code changes or new HMM algorithm are needed.
decision: Do not tune parameters or reopen the failed protected-union branch based on these post-hoc diagnostics. Use findings only to justify a separately precommitted, genuinely different mechanism or a bounded plateau conclusion. No QfO or Three Kingdoms extension, no default promotion and no new uncertainty search.
limits: The retained control is a cached matched downstream replay and union is a fresh pipeline. Stage-associated differences can reflect interacting changed search/graph/profile/candidate/tree/membership steps; endpoint association alone does not isolate a biological cause. Candidate-family scores are explanatory diagnostics, not final orthology claims. All references are development-exposed; shared-host diagnostic time is not pipeline timing.
